source.reference: CWE-770 (allocation without limits) and the well-documented fixed-window burst: a counter keyed to the wall-clock minute permits 2x the limit across the boundary

defect: The limiter counts within a fixed clock minute, so 100 requests at :59 and 100 more at :00 both pass — 200 inside a two-second span.
why_it_is_hard: Both shipped tests pass and the code reads exactly like the criterion. The failure needs two requests either side of a minute boundary, which no test in the change generates.
